preconditions.expression: isinstance(input, str) and input.islower() and not any(c.isspace() for c in input)
preconditions.description: The input must be a lowercase string with no spaces.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == 2 and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of exactly two strings.
Both output strings must have the same length as the input string.
The first output string must have uppercase letters at even indexes (0, 2, ...) and lowercase at odd indexes.
The second output string must have uppercase letters at odd indexes (1, 3, ...) and lowercase at even indexes.
